name: Standard Chartered PLC
summary: Standard Chartered PLC, together with its subsidiaries, provides various banking products and services in Asia, Africa, the Middle East, Europe, and the Americas. The company operates in three segments: Corporate & Investment Banking, Wealth & Retail Banking, and Ventures. It offers retail products, such as deposits, mortgages, credit cards, and personal loans; wealth management products and services that include investments, portfolio management, bancassurance, and wealth advice; and transaction banking services, such as cash management, working capital, trade financing, securities and prime services, and payments and liquidity products.
